integrity: The proof conditions on one order statistic, derives the exact conditional first and second sample sums, and integrates the resulting quadratic against beta moments. A separate Dirichlet-spacing checker independently reconstructs the mixed moment for small and moderate dimensions.
scientific_limitations: The parent distribution must be continuous uniform on a finite interval.
The statistic is the unbiased sample variance, not sample standard deviation.
The 2009 uniform-order-statistic moment paper was available at publication-page and abstract level but not as complete text through the bounded retrieval paths used.
title: Exact order-statistic coupling profile with sample variance under a uniform law
